scope: Read-only, point-in-time verification of an existing N/S/T stage against a caller-supplied candidate schedule and run_id

implementation.case_package: strict ZIP inspection from the already opened regular-file descriptor using positional reads
implementation.tool_policy: strict JSON inspection from bytes captured while hashing the opened descriptor
implementation.toolkit: strict wheel or bundle inspection from bytes captured while hashing the opened descriptor
final_checks: all input descriptors are rehashed and their named entries and metadata rechecked
the extracted case tree and its private files are checked twice
stage.json, input/case/work directories, root entries, and ancestor chain are rechecked

adversarial_reproduction.initial_false_green: a malformed pinned case_package with an undeclared ZIP trailer passed when an ancestor was swapped to a clean copy only during path-based inspect_package calls
adversarial_reproduction.post_fix_cause: ZIP end record is invalid or exceeds package bounds
adversarial_reproduction.reviewer: native read-only development agent, not an external custodian

limitations: The caller-supplied schedule is not authenticated or independently sealed.
A same-UID writer may change the stage after the point-in-time check returns; a future executor must recheck at use.
No runtime isolation, applied limits, provider receipts, model run, blinded rating, or external custody was tested.
The adversarial review was bounded and did not perform fuzzing.
